scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only firestore,functions
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run build && firebase deploy --only functions --project dev
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run build && firebase deploy --only functions --project prod
scripts.test: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-pitmydoro 'node --test test/leaderboard.test.mjs'
